author: IGN
description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Vibe Together, an upcoming multiplayer music-making game. It is a hybrid game and music software that is built around exploration and discovery. Vibe Together will be available on Steam in 2027. A demo is coming soon.

Build songs in a new way by connecting objects together! A visual music sandbox for you to create solo or with friends. No music experience needed. Share what you make with the community and turn each song into a level you can play in different experiences like a rhythm game or a bullet heaven. 

Instead of arranging clips on a timeline, players build together in a shared space of placed nodes and connections. Music is visualized: rhythm is defined by the distance between objects, and pitch is shown by color. Signals travel along the connections, triggering beats and melodies as they reach each node. Players can see how their song works and reshape it while it plays, alone or with up to seven other people.

#IGN #gaming
title: Vibe Together - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Xbox is officially 25 years old! Join IGN's Ryan McCaffrey as he looks back on a quarter-century of Microsoft's Xbox in the console market. We cover everything from the original Xbox and playing Halo: Combat Evolved, Splinter Cell, and KOTOR, to the glory days of the Xbox 360 versus the PS3. Hear his exclusive account of system-sellers like Gears of War, Mass Effect, and Oblivion, the reveal of the Xbox Series X, and discover how the upcoming Project Helix will compete with the PlayStation 6 (PS6) alongside future games like The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel.

#IGN #gaming
title: Xbox at 25: My Memories From Across Xbox’s Entire (and Quite Incredible) History

Check out the trailer for Drag, an upcoming thriller comedy movie starring Lizzy Caplan, Lucy DeVito, John Stamos, and Christine Ko.

Two sisters with a contentious relationship decide to rob a rural home in upstate New York. The simple robbery turns into a nightmare when one of them throws out her back and becomes immobilized on the second floor. The night spirals out of control as they embark on a painful journey to make it out before the homeowner returns.

Drag is produced by Danny DeVito, Lucy DeVito, and Jake DeVito.

Drag, written & directed by Raviv Ullman & Greg Yagolnitzer, opens in US theaters on January 29, 2027.
